invariant: Completion of v1: a substage that reports blocked=true (zero-budget stops such as the Agent provider preflight) is projected like ok=false — its preflight status becomes the stage reason code, its evidence lines the detail, owner EXTERNAL unless the payload names one — so an autopilot stop on gateway unavailability reads PROVIDER_UNAVAILABLE / 'http 503' instead of a bare REAL_BUILD_FAILED.
